Data Analyst
Ashburn, VA • IT

Job Type
Full-time
Description
 Position Summary

The Data Analyst collects, validates, analyzes, and visualizes data from multiple systems to support operations, capacity planning, budgeting, projects, compliance, and executive reporting. This role defines trusted metrics, automates recurring reports, identifies trends, and communicates practical recommendations.



Key Responsibilities

 - Partner with Operations, Development, Finance, IT, OT, and other teams to define reporting and data requirements.

 - Extract, transform, and analyze data using SQL, Excel, Power Query, and approved analytics tools.

 - Build and maintain Power BI dashboards, scorecards, and recurring reports.

 - Analyze trends, variances, risks, and performance drivers, and recommend practical actions.

 - Support data center analysis across capacity, energy, incidents, maintenance, assets, projects, budgets, vendors, and service performance.

 - Validate data, resolve discrepancies, document assumptions, and implement quality checks.

 - Maintain business metrics, data dictionaries, calculation logic, and reporting procedures.

 - Automate recurring data preparation and reporting to reduce manual effort.

 - Present findings clearly to technical, operational, and leadership audiences.

 - Follow CloudHQ security, privacy, access control, and data-handling requirements.

 - Support analytics projects, testing, process improvements, and new reporting capabilities.

Requirements
 Required Qualifications

 - Bachelor's degree in data analytics, statistics, computer science, information systems, business, engineering, finance, or a related field; equivalent experience will be considered.

 - Three to five years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, reporting, or a related role.

 - Intermediate to advanced SQL skills, including joins, aggregations, common table expressions, and data validation.

 - Hands-on experience with Power BI/Tableau, data modeling, Power Query, and DAX.

 - Advanced Excel skills, including formulas, pivot tables, charts, and data transformation.

 - Ability to clean and reconcile data from multiple systems and explain findings to nontechnical stakeholders.

 - Experience gathering requirements, documenting business logic, and managing multiple priorities independently.

 - Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills, with close attention to accuracy.



Preferred Qualifications

 - Experience with data center, facilities, energy, construction, infrastructure, or other mission-critical operational data.

 - Experience with Azure data services, Microsoft Fabric, data warehouses, APIs, ETL/ELT workflows, or cloud analytics platforms.

 - Working knowledge of Python, R, PowerShell, or another language used for analysis and automation.

 - Familiarity with forecasting, anomaly detection, or predictive analytics.

 - Experience with BMS, EPMS, DCIM, CMMS, asset management, service management, finance, or project management data.

 - Understanding of data governance, role-based access, change control, and ISO 27001 or SOC practices.

 - Microsoft Power BI or Tableau Data Analyst certification or a comparable credential.



Core Competencies

 - Analytical thinking and structured problem-solving

 - Data quality and attention to detail

 - Business partnership and requirements gathering

 - Clear data storytelling and visualization

 - Accountability, integrity, and sound judgment

 - Process improvement and an automation mindset

 - Teamwork, adaptability, and knowledge sharing



Success Measures

 - Deliver accurate, timely, and decision-ready reporting.

 - Increase stakeholder adoption and trust in dashboards and defined metrics.

 - Reduce manual reporting effort through repeatable automation.

 - Improve data completeness, consistency, traceability, and documentation.

 - Translate analysis into measurable operational or business improvements.



Working Conditions

 - Work in an office or hybrid environment, based on business needs.

 - Travel occasionally to CloudHQ data center campuses.

 - Provide limited after-hours support for critical reporting deadlines or operational events.

 - Comply with confidentiality, information security, and site access requirements.

cover_letter:
I am writing to express my interest in the Data Analyst position at CloudHQ. With a solid foundation in systems analysis, a Master's degree in Information and Communication Systems from Unicamp, and years of experience delivering analytics, automation, and continuous improvement solutions at Bosch, I welcome the opportunity to support CloudHQ's operational reporting and infrastructure analysis.

Throughout my career, I have focused on translating operational requirements into trusted, actionable metrics. In my work across Bosch Brasil and Bosch Hungary, I built dynamic analytical tools, digitized reporting procedures, and integrated data using SQL, advanced Excel, and Power BI. My background combines end-to-end data preparation-from extracting, cleaning, and validating records across disparate systems to structuring clear visual dashboards-with a focus on repeatability and data consistency.

In addition to reporting, I apply an automation-first mindset to recurring workflows. Using tools such as Python, SQL Server, and automated scripts, I have eliminated manual data preparation bottlenecks to deliver timely, dependable business intelligence. My experience in continuous improvement (CIP) and structured problem-solving has also trained me to partner directly with cross-functional teams, document data definitions transparently, and communicate key performance drivers to both technical and operational stakeholders.

I am eager to bring my background in data modeling, dashboard development, and analytical problem-solving to CloudHQ's mission-critical operations. Thank you for your time and consideration, and I look forward to the possibility of discussing how my experience aligns with your team's goals.
cover_letter_closing:
Sincerely,
Eduardo Matos de Assis Figueiredo
